instruction: Pre-filled. Do not reorder the rows.
Number to the nearest 0.5 Hz between 4 and 14, or choose 'absent'. 'absent' is a real answer: do not enter a best guess.
0 = absent or fragmented, 1 = poorly formed, 2 = well formed and rhythmic.

Pattern of the slowing. Choose 'na' if there is none.
Interhemispheric amplitude or frequency asymmetry beyond normal limits.
MUSCLE artefact specifically. Do not count blink, eye movement, ECG, electrode pop or movement; note those under reader_notes.
Where muscle activity is maximal, recorded even when the artefact is mild.
Drowsiness produces the same spectral changes the instrument is asked to detect, so this field can change the study's conclusions.
Overall impression of the record. Not a diagnosis.
